	)

Tried a first prompt on a subset of random targets from various TAs, and asked the LLM the following:

````python
	
	prompt = f'''Hello, can you get acquainted with all the following NACE classification categories: {NACElevel0}, {NACElevel1}, {NACElevel2} and {NACElevel3}.
	Then look at this list of targets: {targets_list}
	
	My task for you is the following: for each target, analyse its content description and assign to each target a NACE category for each level (0,1,2,3).
	
	If there is some overlap, add the multiple categories possibilites (up to maximum 3 per NACE level).
	
	(Don't forget to provide the title of the target).le Provide your answer as a list in Markdown format please.
	
	For each target, write one or max 2 sentences justifying your choice. Thank you!'''
	
	
	print(prompt)````

I didn't specify yet a hierarchy in the targets and let the LLM assign NACE categories at every level for each targets (allowing a maximum overlap of 3 NACE categories per NACE level), while also asking for justification.
